game.name: Dead to Rights : Retribution (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,Es,It)
game.desc: Dead to Rights: Retribution on Xbox 360 is an action game that takes us into the gloomy alleys of Grant City. As Jack Slate, a determined policeman, the player must use his weapons to rid the area of the many criminals who have taken up residence there. To achieve this, Jack is supported by Shadow, a combat-trained dog that you can control at regular intervals.
